from typing import Any, List

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class Proto(BaseModel):
    polluted: int


class Prototype(BaseModel):
    x: int


class Constructor(BaseModel):
    prototype: Prototype


class Root(BaseModel):
    proto: Proto = Field(alias="__proto__")
    constructor: Constructor
    toString: str
    hasOwnProperty: Any
    valueOf: List[Any]
    define_getter: int = Field(alias="__defineGetter__")

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

final class Root
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly Proto $proto,
        public readonly Constructor $constructor,
        public readonly string $toString,
        public readonly mixed $hasOwnProperty,
        /** @var mixed[] */
        public readonly array $valueOf,
        public readonly int $defineGetter,
    ) {
    }

    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            proto: Proto::fromArray($data['__proto__']),
            constructor: Constructor::fromArray($data['constructor']),
            toString: $data['toString'],
            hasOwnProperty: $data['hasOwnProperty'],
            valueOf: $data['valueOf'],
            defineGetter: $data['__defineGetter__'],
        );
    }
}

final class Proto
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly int $polluted,
    ) {
    }

    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            polluted: $data['polluted'],
        );
    }
}

final class Constructor
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly Prototype $prototype,
    ) {
    }

    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            prototype: Prototype::fromArray($data['prototype']),
        );
    }
}

final class Prototype
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly int $x,
    ) {
    }

    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            x: $data['x'],
        );
    }
}
